healthcare.medical_coverage: 100% premium paid for employee, 80% for dependents (PPO or HDHP options)
healthcare.dental_vision: Comprehensive dental with annual $2,000 maximum; annual vision exams and hardware allowance $300
healthcare.mental_health: Up to 12 free therapy sessions per year via Modern Health

retirement.401k_matching: 100% match on the first 4% of salary, immediate vesting

learning_development.annual_education_budget: $2,500 per employee for books, conferences, certifications, and online courses
learning_development.approval_process: Self-approved up to $500, manager approval for higher amounts

wellness.wellness_days: 2 company-wide mental wellness recharge days per quarter
